parsed.name: DXP数字脉冲处理多道分析系统
parsed.name_en: DXP Digital Pulse Processor MCA System
parsed.description: 用于辐射谱学和X射线荧光测量的数字脉冲处理与多道分析电子学系统。它接收探测器脉冲信号，进行数字脉冲处理、计数和能量分道，生成能谱数据。常用于同步辐射实验、XRF/EDS分析和核谱测量。
parsed.description_en: A digital pulse-processing and multichannel analyzer system for radiation spectroscopy and X-ray fluorescence measurements. It accepts detector pulse signals, performs digital pulse processing, counting, and energy binning, and produces spectral data. It is commonly used in synchrotron experiments, XRF/EDS analysis, and nuclear spectroscopy.

actions.description_en: Read a low-level digital processing parameter from the device.

actions.description: 按当前预置模式和计数设置准备设备进入采集状态。
actions.description_en: Prepare the device for acquisition using the current preset mode and counting settings.
